headline: On the current post-repair model, replacing the model predicted contact mask with a PERFECT ground-truth engagement mask changes contact_f1 by -0.000401 with 95% CI [-0.001426, +0.000617], a precise null. The engagement gap closes by -0.69%. The sealed cell-U finding of significant HARM was an artifact of its degenerate over-broad mask; the corrected reading is no effect, tightly bounded.
next_action: Record cellu-null. The inference-time contact-mask direction is closed for practical purposes on the current model, by a tight null rather than by the voided harm finding, so no further inference-time mask work is warranted. W3 geometry-term training is no longer blocked by this dependency. The engagement gap remains attributable to something other than mask selection, which is now supported by a precise null instead of by a confounded harm.
non_claims: Not a model score. Ground-truth contact does not exist at inference; both arms of this contrast are non-deployable probes and their 18 protocol metrics must never enter baseline.md, the evidence-index headline table, or any model comparison.
Does NOT re-establish the sealed cell-U number or restore comparability with it. Cell U lives entirely pre-repair and cannot be re-measured in its own configuration.
Does not reopen the P5/P6 predicted-mask sub-term sweep, verified unaffected: all 9 sibling arms use contact_mask_source=predicted and both read points sit inside the ground-truth gate.

Does not bound what a better TRAINED contact head would buy; it bounds only the inference-time mask selection at the shipped guidance dose (last 10 of 500 steps, clamp 1.0). P5 already showed that dose-response is flat.
Overwrites no sealed result. The voided cell-U values are preserved byte for byte and this outcome is an independent row.
Says nothing about P14 height contraction; the two are orthogonal.
preregistration: docs/plan/PHASE_1B_HOI/05_INFERENCE_GUIDANCE.md, section "preregistration (2026-08-22): corrected cell U"; registry row p1-hoi-p6-cellu-corrected-mask-preregister-s42-20260822

consequences: The preregistered gate G2 (bitwise reproduction of the sealed 2026-08-04 B0 per_sequence hash) is unsatisfiable by construction and was replaced by the equivalent gate against the SEALED POST-REPAIR baseline, which passed bitwise.

The preregistered comparability with the sealed cell-U number is permanently unavailable: cell U lives entirely pre-repair. Only the practical question (does a perfect engagement mask help the CURRENT model) is answerable, and that is what is answered here.
The preregistered gate G5 clause "same checkpoint as the sealed cell U" is not met, deliberately, and is superseded by "same checkpoint in both arms of this contrast".
preregistration_deviation.gpu_cost_of_the_deviation: two extra rollouts, ~3.1 min wall clock; the aborted pre-patch control failed before any GPU work (FileNotFoundError on a copied code tree) and consumed none. Total ~6.3 min against the 12 min ceiling.
preregistration_deviation.rule_already_on_record: docs/HOIPRIOR_EVIDENCE_INDEX.md:593 states the scope rule "no cell crosses the 2026-08-19 representation repair". The preregistration violated a rule that was already written down; that is a specification error, not a discovery.
preregistration_deviation.what: The preregistration pinned the sealed cell-U checkpoint (D2-AI, a190e56c...a224) for comparability with the sealed 2026-08-05 result. That configuration was executed FIRST and is not able to answer the question, so the measurement was repeated on the post-repair P12 checkpoint (722d83ee...3704) and only the P12 pair carries the verdict.
preregistration_deviation.why: The D2-AI checkpoint was trained BEFORE the 2026-08-19 representation repair. Under repaired code its own predicted-mask baseline collapses: contact_f1 0.675702 -> 0.097631 (0.14x), mpjpe 11.7699 -> 59.4331 cm (5.05x), feet_height 0.046125 -> 0.699227 (15.16x), while gt_contact_percent is unchanged at 0.661883 (ratio exactly 1.000), which places the change on the model side and not in the data path. A contrast measured in that regime cannot bound anything about guidance on a working model.

The tracked tool fixes 10000 by the 2026-08-09 P10 protocol, and the sealed cell-U interval was produced under that same protocol, so 10000 is used and the deviation is toward the established standard rather than away from it.

engagement_gap_closure.authority: point estimate only; contact_percent is aggregate-only and has no bootstrap CI

type: inference-only ground-truth-contact-mask upper-bound probe, re-measured on a corrected mask; no training, no checkpoint change, no evaluator metric change
what_this_establishes: A PERFECT inference-time contact engagement mask buys nothing measurable on the current model: delta_contact_f1 -0.000401 [-0.001426, +0.000617], engagement gap closure -0.69%.

The sealed cell-U verdict of significant HARM does not survive the mask repair. Its sign was an artifact of an over-broad mask applying contact guidance on frames ground truth says are not in contact.

The practical content of the old abort is therefore restored on valid evidence but with the sign corrected from harm to a precise null, and it now applies to the post-repair model rather than to the pre-repair one it was measured on.

Four metrics move significantly and all four are trivial in size: end_obj_trans_err +0.0162 cm on a 2.761 cm baseline (0.6%, worse), mpjpe -0.0106 cm (better), trans_dist -0.0072 cm (better), human_pen_ratio -0.00079 (better). None is a contact metric.
